evidence: A landslide fell at Four Kilo in Ichhakamana-6 at about 4:15 am and blocked the road.
After the morning debris was cleared, a new landslide fell at the same place that evening and blocked the road again.
Mud-laden landslide activity affected Jyotinagar, Butwal-4, on Sunday (Bhadau 13), burying/damaging houses.
The article states the damaging Jyotinagar landslides occurred on both Sunday and Monday (Bhadau 13 and 14), indicating a second occurrence/day.
A landslide at Seti Dobhan in Bharatpur-29 blocked the road on the previous evening.
A separate landslide at Panchkilo in Bharatpur-29 blocked the road on the previous evening.
A landslide at Chainpur-4 helped dam the river before the destructive Hewa Khola flood.
A separate landslide at Panchkhapan-9 also helped dam the river before the flood.
Falling rocks at Tuin Khola blocked the Muglin-Narayangadh road on the evening of July 13.
Mud/debris descending from above at Seti Dobhan separately blocked the road on July 13.
A new landslide fell near Jalbire around 6:30 am on July 14 and again closed the road.
